ambiguities.text: The EIP does not specify how to handle conflicts if the referenced execution-specs and consensus-specs have incompatible definitions.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the referenced specific versions are authoritative and conflicts indicate implementation bugs rather than spec issues.

ambiguities.text: The term 'de-duplication' is not precisely defined - unclear if this means removing duplicate text or just providing cross-references.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume de-duplication means providing canonical pointers to avoid maintaining duplicate specifications, not removing existing spec text.

implicit_assumptions.description: The referenced execution-specs and consensus-specs repositories contain correct and complete specifications.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If referenced repositories have errors or omissions, implementations following those specs would be incorrect.

implicit_assumptions.description: Developers and implementers will use EIP-7568 as the authoritative reference for finding upgrade specifications.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If developers use outdated or incorrect sources, implementations may diverge causing consensus failures.

implicit_assumptions.description: The timestamp-based activation mechanism (EIP-6953, EIP-6122) works correctly to coordinate EL and CL upgrades.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Activation timing mismatch between EL and CL could cause chain splits or consensus failures.
